answer: One operator can still spray thousands of keys from a single rack. Entry is a split-shift: the claimant plants a 3.4 kg marked anchor on mesa terrace 6, then a second observer 9.2 km seaward on an ocean pier radios strain every 20 seconds for 11 hours, both clocks locked to the same NTP merkle. Bond is 39 POA for 7 days. Auditors reject any pair whose lag variance exceeds 1.3 s or whose strain traces have Pearson r above 0.86 across applicants. A second key that reuses the terrace slot or drops more than five radio rounds forfeits 52% of the bond and is locked out of terrace 6 for 6 epochs.
